name: How long does a typical shower replacement take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical shower replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a shower replacement can vary based on the complexity of the project. A basic shower replacement, such as installing a new pre-fabricated unit, might take as little as 1-3 days. More extensive projects involving custom tiling, moving plumbing lines, or reconfiguring the bathroom layout could take 3-7 days or even longer. We aim to complete projects efficiently while ensuring quality, minimizing disruption to your daily routine. We will provide a more accurate timeline after assessing your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: A basic shower replacement typically takes 1-3 days, while more complex projects with custom tiling or plumbing adjustments can take 3-7 days or more.
